profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | Engineering Management | Software Architecture | Applied AI
profile.summary:
I’m Alex. A software engineer and Principal Software Engineer at Sngular, where I have worked since 2012.

Over the years I have had different roles and worked on different projects, mostly in banking and financial services. These days, much of my job is about helping engineering teams work well: setting priorities, supporting people, making technical decisions, and trying to make sure what we build is useful and built well.

I still enjoy software and understanding how things work. My technical background includes Java, Python, AWS, Google Cloud, MySQL, and MongoDB, although I try not to get too attached to any particular tool. Technology changes; judgment and the willingness to keep learning matter more.

AI is taking up a lot of my thinking right now. I use it every day and I am learning how to work with assistants and agents: defining goals and guardrails, managing context, and building solid verification and validation steps. I do not have a finished thesis, and I do not pretend to know more than I do. I experiment, learn, and write about what I see.
I share that work at https://alexdepablos.com.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Principal Software Engineer, I have broader responsibility for engineering team management and organizational leadership within SNGULAR.

• Lead and manage the engineering team, aligning priorities, goals, and capacity with business needs.
• Support engineers’ professional growth, fostering autonomy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Partner with technical and business leaders to facilitate decision-making and the execution of key initiatives.
• Champion engineering best practices, clear communication, and quality to build high-performing teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Team leader in a 6 people team focused on improving and testing the identity services which makes up the  authentication layer on Capital One bank.

✤✤✤ Responsibilities ✤✤✤
⚐ Design solutions to improve the performance and resilience of the MFA layer.
⚐ Manage the team workflow, from gathering the requirements to the final implantation.
⚐ Close contact with product decision makers.
⚐ Production support.

✤✤✤ Technological environment ✤✤✤
⚐ J2EE and Spring framework.
⚐ Dockerization and Amazon Web Services infrastructure.
⚐ CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins.
⚐ Karate framework for testing.
⚐ Follow Scrum methodology with JIRA and Confluence as the main management tools.

positions.description:
